text:
cara - AE: Quick: client Meridian wants a 7-day Private POC (onprem + AWS). Ask: PrivateLink vs TGW, TLS inspect impact, and a short pasteable firewall rule + ballpark network cost for ~8TB egress.

vijay - solutions eng: Short: PrivateLink = fastest, per-VPC ENIs, lower ops. TGW = better for many spokes and preserves src-ip if you control routing. For 7-day POC PrivateLink is usually simplest.

lee - netops: Ops notes: ENI per AZ for HA. If edge SNATs we see ENI IPs not client IPs  to preserve src-ip avoid SNAT or use 1:1 NAT. BGP only required for TGW/transit.

anya - security: TLS inspect: if they terminate TLS our mTLS/client certs break and streaming can fail if proxy buffers. Recommend bypass/passthrough rules for our ENI CIDRs. We'll provide SOC2/KMS bullets.

lee - netops: Pasteable firewall snippet (replace CIDRs with list we'll send):
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.99.200.0/28","10.99.201.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Redwood Private ENIs"
# preserve-src-ip: ensure no SNAT between app subnets and ENI route or use 1:1 NAT

vijay - solutions eng: Ballpark network add-on: PrivateLink endpoint ~$0.012/hr + data processing ~$0.01/GB. For 8TB (~8000GB) data ~ $80 + endpoint hours (2 AZ) =~ $4 -> ~ $84 (region dependent).

cara - AE: Action items: lee upload ENI CIDRs + SNAT example into ticket MR-POC-900; vijay attach cost sketch; anya draft questionnaire bullets. Target EOD PT.
